findings.detail: The added _index_lock_age_seconds duplicates an existing capability of the same name and near-identical body at reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2029; promotion_scope already imports from merge, so merge cannot delegate without a cycle and the owner is arguably merge, but the addition copies the logic rather than extending the existing owner (the merge-side default INDEX_LOCK_STALE_SECONDS is new, so the two now diverge in purpose, which is worth recording rather than blocking on).
